commitResults.messageTitle: Add help for specific commands with UG links
commitResults.messageBody:
HelpCommand now supports 'help COMMAND' to show usage info for a
specific command (e.g. 'help add', 'help delete'). Both 'help' and
'help COMMAND' open the help window with relevant content and a
link to the corresponding User Guide page.

Key changes:
- Add HelpInfo class to carry message-URL pairs
- Replace boolean showHelp in CommandResult with HelpInfo
- HelpCommand maps each command to its MESSAGE_USAGE and UG page URL
- HelpWindow now displays dynamic content and copies command-specific URL
- HelpWindow.fxml switched to VBox layout with text wrapping
- Help menu now has per-command menu items; 'User Guide' opens general help
- MainWindow handlers route each menu item to 'help COMMAND'

Unknown commands show an error with a list of available commands.
Plain 'help' shows the default User Guide link.

Fixes #214
Add help for specific commands

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix note clear oldest accepting negative numbers
commitResults.messageBody:
Validate that numLines is positive in NoteCommandParser.parseNumLines().
Previously, negative values passed through to List.subList() causing
IndexOutOfBoundsException.

Fixes #219

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix Note.equals() and hashCode() to include timePoint
commitResults.messageBody:
Note.equals() and hashCode() previously only compared the text value,
ignoring the timePoint (reminder) field. This violated the equals/hashCode
contract and could cause reminder data to be silently lost in collections.

Now compares timePoint via toString() since TimePoint does not implement
equals/hashCode. Updated tests to include timePoint in expected Notes.

Fixes #220

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix Contact.equals() and hashCode() to include notes
commitResults.messageBody:
Contact.equals() and hashCode() previously ignored the notes field,
meaning two contacts with different notes were considered equal.
This could cause note data loss during deduplication or collection operations.

Fixed tests that were incorrectly passing due to the bug.

Fixes #221
Fix Contact.equals() and hashCode() to include notes
Fix Note.equals() and hashCode() to include timePoint
Fix note clear oldest accepting negative numbers

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix find @INDEX to support bidirectional cross-referencing
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously, find @INDEX only performed a forward lookup — it showed
contacts referenced in the target's notes. It did not show contacts
whose notes reference the target.

Added reverse lookup in FindAssociationsCommand that iterates all
contacts and checks if their notes contain a reference to the target
contact's UUID. Combined forward and reverse results.

Updated UG documentation for find @INDEX to describe the bidirectional
behavior accurately.

Fixes #260
